direction.grid: 1366x768, 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; main split into independent reserved zones with no overlap: rendered scene at least 70% of main, plus separate callout, station and job zones; single non-wrapping horizontal rail of equal targets at least 36px high with aria-current and arrow-key movement; condense side content inside its reserved zone without overlap or scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68), emerald/neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text and only one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text with no other hue; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, header tab labels at least 16px, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels minimum, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; no label under 12px
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left, large header tabs spanning most of the header, and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps provider identity readiness checks separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver idle machines, stopped cell shown with silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks visible beside the approved recovery plan while replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the rendered factory scene to at least 70% of main and shrink the right evidence zone, keeping callouts, stations and jobs in separate reserved zones.
Raise legend and station micro-labels to at least 12px and body copy to 16px/24 so the bottom legend remains legible at 1366x768.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring with offset to the Receiving, CELL-MILL-1, CELL-MILL-2 and job nodes in the SVG, with arrow-key movement between nodes.

Split the right zone into two clearly separated panels: provider identity readiness check with its own status and control, and investigation as a distinct evidence task with its own status and Run control.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main; the repeated Certificate/Receiving block currently competes with the factory stations and jobs.
Increase select and helper text to 16px and ensure the select, check control and primary each show the neon focus ring and pointer style only when enabled.
Make each recovery option a full 16px radio row at least 44px high so selecting it clearly opens the typed consent form, instead of the small Select this path pill.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main and link hovering or focusing each option to the matching route and job zone in the SVG.
Raise FINISH and INCREMENTAL micro-labels to 12px and keep the No acceptance recorded status in the action-bar centre.
Enlarge the proposed-task scene area and keep the three untracked proposals visually distinct from tracked work with dashed silver borders and PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on every card.
Reduce empty space in the right proposal panel by enlarging task detail to 16px and aligning the 1-2-3 task switcher at least 36px high with aria-current.
Add focus ring and bidirectional highlighting between each left task card and its right-zone detail.
Confirm the stopped preview uses only silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; remove any preview wording that implies a live state before Apply.
Enlarge the factory route SVG within the scene zone so the neon recovery flow and the offline preview read at a glance, without shrinking job cards below 16px.
Make the machine selector at least 44px high with a neon focus ring and announce the invalidation consequence in an aria-live status.
Refit CELL-MILL-2 to silver cross-hatching with a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, replacing the large diagonal cross lines that read as a generic error.
Keep provider identity readiness and investigation evidence as separate headed panels with independent status, as in the required side-zone contract.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main and show feasible neon routes only through online cells, with no route through the offline cell.
Apply silver cross-hatching plus cross marker and OFFLINE text to the constrained Split option and to CELL-MILL-2 consistently, using pattern and text rather than colour alone.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main and visually link the constrained option in both zones so its unavailable state is identical in each.
Raise FINISH and INCREMENTAL labels to 12px and keep fresh review required status centred in the action bar at 16px.
Keep the 3 blocked prior tasks and the 3 proposed replacements in visually separate sub-zones, with blocked shown hatched and proposed dashed and explicitly untracked until approval.
Enlarge the left scene so CELL-MILL-2 reads OFFLINE with silver cross-hatching and cross marker, matching the right-zone state.
Sync focus and highlight between left task cards 01-03 and the right proposed-task detail, with at least 36px switcher targets.
Enlarge the three proof cards to fill the scene zone and raise LOCKED and step labels so the sequence reads without relying on the right zone.
Increase right-zone checklist and passphrase guidance to a clear 16px, keep the input at least 44px high, and show the neon focus ring on Verify ledger, the input and Export controls.
State tracked, done and blocked counts at 16px in the action-bar centre and announce Verify completion with aria-live polite.
Add a clear completed-state heading in the scene zone at 24px so SEALED on all three cards is paired with one plain completion sentence, with minimal narration.
Ensure the Complete rail item carries aria-current and the header Proof tab and rail agree, with arrow-key movement still available on the horizontal rail.
Raise the bottom status and legend to at least 12px for labels and 16px for the PACKET SEALED status, preserving the black, emerald and brushed silver palette only.
